name: Hiiragi Michiru
source:
An acting prodigy, Michiru has a high standing in the US.
She has various insights into the way the world works,
but it seems as though she'd rather have fun than think deeply.

[from [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20071113213514/http://www.hirameki-int.com/apdvd/products/dayoflove/p_cha04.html]Hirameki[/url]]
